title: Mixed Event — Rise as One! — Episode1 As Partners

meta.Event Outline: On one of his daily runs, Akito has an encounter with a dog and his owner. The pair has been training day by day in the hopes of one day winning a national disc dog competition. But the day before their next competition, this dog owner sprains his ankle...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That's it for my run, but I still feel pretty good...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I think I'll do another lap after I get a drink of water. The vending machines should be...)

Ready, Max?
Okay... Go get it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That guy's here with his dog again. They've been here basically every day recently...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And that thing they're playing with... It's called a flying disc, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's not that big a dog, but it looks pretty intense when it's running around...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Anyway, I need to grab some water.)

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
Sir!
I'm sorry, but our flying disc flew your way and...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
If their disc's over here, then that means...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No...!
I-It's coming right towards me...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Wait, the disc...!
If I throw it somewhere far in that direction...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Did I go a little overboard there...?
I'm not sure it'll be able to get...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What? No way...
It caught it by jumping?

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry...!
Are you alright?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm okay...
I'm also sorry for throwing your disc without asking.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Still, seeing him charge towards you like that must've been very startling. I apologize for not being able to stop him sooner. I put an extra-long leash on him, but panicked and couldn't get a good grip on it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Oh, he did have a leash on. I got all worked up over noth—)

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Max.
That was an amazing catch you made back there! I didn't think you'd be able to get it after seeing how far our friend here threw your disc.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Speaking of which, that was a beautiful throw! Your form was remarkable! Do you play ultimate a lot?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, um... I haven't thrown a flying disc since I was little.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Really?! Then, you must be a natural athlete! I wish I could do what you can! I'm still working on how to throw one of these properly...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
O-Oh, I see...
That explains why you two have been here so often lately.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: I've actually been thinking about entering us into an agility contest that involves dogs catching discs... It's called “disc dog”.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Yes! And those who do well in enough of them get to compete on the national stage.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Our dream is to become the number one team in the country!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I think he just replied to you...

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
Haha. I think so too...
Sometimes it seems like he knows exactly what I'm saying.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: But Border Collies are very smart, so maybe he does understand...

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I've been going on and on about Max without introducing myself. My name is Itsuki Ishihara. And you are...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Akito Shinonome.
Also, I'm still in high school, so I'm not as old as you may think I am.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Wait, I'm also a high schooler!
It's nice to meet you, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It was nice meeting you both.
Anyway, I should get going...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Huh?! H-He's looking right at me for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
What's the matter, Max?
Oh, do you want Shinonome to pet you...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? He wants me to pet him?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Yes. After he's pulled off a nice play, he always sits like this and asks for pets.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: He wants you to pet him because you were the one who threw the disc last.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Do you not like dogs, Shinonome?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Umm, well... I'm not the biggest fan of them.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
No, I'm so sorry for not asking sooner!
Also, I apologize for keeping you here so long...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, that's okay. I should've said something sooner too.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Our dream is to become the number one team in the country!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They're also working towards a goal as partners...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I feel like running that extra mile now.
